basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Office Assistant - Adm & Accts Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy (SRIC) of the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has invited online applications for 2 temporary Office Assistant - Adm & Accts posts in the Outreach Promotion Fund project (Project Code R/OPM) of the Department of Continuing Education & Technology (CE&T). The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 40,000 per month, the tenure is 12 months or the end of the project, whichever is earlier, and the essential qualification is a Master's in any discipline. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints a heading for desired experience but gives no details under it. It also states that the qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and that mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. The official notification should be checked for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation for the Office Assistant - Adm & Accts post is up to Rs. 40,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The assignment is described as temporary.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts of Office Assistant - Adm & Accts in the Outreach Promotion Fund project (Project Code R/OPM).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application cut-off date is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is Masters in any Discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 40,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is shown as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 1 December 2026 at 10:30 AM at the CEP Conference Room, IIT Kharagpur, Main Building, 1st Floor.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the assignment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The assignment is temporary.

faq.question: Q9. Does having the qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
